trends.headline: Karl sitting on Twin Peaks again
trends.snippet: Visibility at the lookout is a rumor until 2pm. Jacket weather on the west side.

trends.headline: BART delays through Embarcadero
trends.snippet: Yellow line crawling. People are walking Market instead. Bring a book.

trends.headline: Mission burrito discourse, round 4,000
trends.snippet: Foil vs no foil. Super vs regular. Everyone is wrong except your spot.

trends.headline: Giants weekend series at the yard
trends.snippet: Oracle Park wind is doing that thing. Extra innings energy on the Muni ride home.

trends.headline: Still telling people it is 415
trends.snippet: Overlay numbers keep showing up. The area code is a personality now.

trends.headline: Golden Gate in full International Orange
trends.snippet: Clear enough to see the towers from Crissy. Rare. Screenshot it.

seed.name: Karl the Fog
seed.text: Parked on Twin Peaks until further notice. If you can see the bridge, take a picture. You will not get this again this week.

seed.name: BART Watcher
seed.text: Embarcadero is a suggestion right now. Yellow line 18 minutes. I am walking Market. Again.

seed.name: Mission Foil
seed.text: Hot take nobody asked for: if it is not wrapped like a silver brick, it is a wrap, not a burrito. La Taqueria stans, I see you. We can still be friends.

seed.name: Yardbird
seed.text: Giants night, wind off the bay, garlic fries in the upper deck. This is the whole personality.

seed.name: Bridge Cat
seed.text: International Orange hitting different this morning. Crissy Field is doing the postcard thing. 415 out.

seed.name: Six Two Eight
seed.text: New number came in as 628. I still tell people it is 415. The overlay is real and I refuse to emotionally accept it.

seed.name: Dolores Blanket
seed.text: Dolores is a quilt of strangers by 1pm. Someone is always flying a kite into someone else’s charcuterie.

seed.name: Outerlands Kid
seed.text: Judah is a wind tunnel, the ocean is loud, and parking is a folk tale. Would not live anywhere else.
